diagnosis.what_happened: An unanchored 4-digit regex mistakenly captured a year in meta-annotation prose instead of a valid bibliographic entry.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Permissive parsing rules failed to distinguish between valid bibliographic syntax and surrounding conversational/meta prose.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: The parser should have verified structural bibliographic components and excluded non-bibliographic text blocks.
diagnosis.rationale_why: Rigorous extraction requires explicit syntax boundaries to prevent data corruption from context pollution.

desired_behavior: Enforce strict bibliographic component verification using anchored regex and explicit exclusion of meta-annotation prose prior to parsing.
generalization: All parsing of structured academic data from mixed text must anchor to formal syntax boundaries and exclude surrounding conversational contexts.

evidence.observed_value: False positive year extraction from prose
